g.text: Sensitivity to weights, recovery controls, and the preperiod
All intervals use state-plus-quarter working covariance. Positive values mean the Q5 contrast moves upward, not that Q5 employment necessarily rises.
Specifications are diagnostic sensitivities. A nominally significant positive contrast is not an AI benefit estimate.
